capabilities: record audio from the microphone or transcribe uploaded audio files
transcribe audio through cloud or local providers with speaker diarization
insert transcripts with timestamps that link back to the audio
summarize transcriptions and chat with them using LLM providers
queue multiple files for batch transcription
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README mixes English and Spanish. The default transcription provider, spob, appears to be the author's own pay-as-you-go service.
problem: Obsidian can record audio but has no built-in way to transcribe recordings or identify who said what.
